hints.title: Divisibility Constraints by Digit
hints.text: Divisibility by 1, 3, or 9 is satisfied by all 9s. Divisibility by 2 or 5 dictates boundary digits 8 or 5. Divisibility by 4 or 8 dictates 2 or 3 boundary digits.

hints.title: Center Digit Degrees of Freedom
hints.text: Outer digits are constrained by divisibility rules, leaving only the central digits flexible to satisfy the remaining modular congruence.

hints.title: Greedy Digit Descent
hints.text: Iterate candidate center digits descending from nine down to zero and test modular equivalence using precomputed powers of ten.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

variables: n: number of digits in the palindrome
complexity.notes: Direct string construction with at most ten modular checks.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Searching all 10^(n/2) palindromes times out for large n.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Applies modular arithmetic divisibility tests with greedy palindrome center placement.
